count_ads.description: Count the Platsbanken ads a search matches, and the positions they hire for, without reading the ads. Optionally break the count down by occupation field, group or occupation, or by region, municipality or country, largest first: how many nursing jobs each region has, say. broader.definition: Analyserar, designar och utvecklar IT-system eller delar av system. Utformar och utvecklar lösningar för programvara, applikationer, system och databaser.
broader.label: Mjukvaru- och systemutvecklare m.fl.

broader.definition:
Undersöker, analyserar och utvärderar kunders behov av informationsteknik, deras processer eller problem och utvecklar och genomför förslag, rekommendationer, och planer för att förbättra existerande eller framtida informationssystem.
I arbetsuppgifterna ingår:
(a) att samråda med användare för att formulera och dokumentera behov och med ledningen för överensstämmelse med systemprinciper 
(b) att identifiera och analysera affärsprocesser och arbetsmetoder 
(c) att identifiera och utvärdera ineffektiva metoder och rekommendera optimal affärspraxis och systemfunktionalitet 
(d) att ansvara för utveckling av funktionella lösningar, såsom att skapa, anpassa och genomföra kontrollplaner för system 
(e) att utveckla funktionella specifikationer för systemutvecklare 
(f) att utveckla eller ändra system för att förbättra arbetsflödet eller för nya syften 
(g) att samordna och sammanlänka datasystem inom en organisation för ökad kompatibilitet.
broader.label: Systemutvecklare och analytiker

concept.definition:
Programmerare analyserar, designar och bygger mjukvara.

Ofta får programmeraren instruktioner i form av en kravspecifikation som kommit från en behovsanalys. Programmeraren avgör i vilken ordning systemet bör byggas och översätter kraven till programmeringsspråk.

Källa: SACO, ISCO

parameters.description: Words to look for in the ad's title, text and employer. Ads are in Swedish, so search in Swedish: Platsbanken recognises occupations, skills and places among the words, so 'sjuksköterska Malmö' finds nursing jobs in Malmö. Quote words for an exact phrase, or put a minus before a word to leave it out. Leave empty to search with the other fields alone.
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.description: Only ads in these broad fields, such as Data/IT or Hälso- och sjukvård. Pick from the list, or give concept ids. Leave empty for every field.
parameters.name: occupation_fields

parameters.description: Only ads in this occupation group (SSYK 2012, the Swedish standard classification), such as Mjukvaru- och systemutvecklare m.fl. (2512). Search the list, or type concept ids, several separated by commas. Leave empty for every group.
parameters.name: occupation_groups

parameters.description: Only ads for this occupation, such as Systemutvecklare/Programmerare or Sjuksköterska, grundutbildad. Search the list, or type concept ids from 'Look up taxonomy concepts', several separated by commas. Leave empty for every occupation.
parameters.name: occupations

parameters.description: Only ads asking for these skills, as taxonomy concept ids: find one with 'Look up taxonomy concepts' (type Skill), such as qfkh_ZRK_w4W for Python. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any skill.
parameters.name: skills

parameters.description: Only ads in these Swedish regions (län), such as Stockholms län. Pick from the list, or give concept ids (other countries' regions have them too). Leave empty for everywhere.
parameters.name: regions

parameters.description: Only ads in this municipality (kommun), such as Göteborg. Search the list, or type concept ids, several separated by commas. Leave empty for everywhere.
parameters.name: municipalities

parameters.description: Only ads in this country. Nearly every ad is in Sweden (Sverige); pick another country for the few jobs abroad, or type concept ids, several separated by commas. Leave empty for all.
parameters.name: countries

parameters.description: Only ads from this employer: its name, or its Swedish organisation number as digits (which also matches numbers starting with them).
parameters.name: employer

parameters.description: Only ads with one of these employment types. Leave empty for every type.
parameters.name: employment_types

parameters.description: Only full-time or only part-time jobs. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: working_hours

parameters.description: Only ads whose text mentions working remotely, or only ads that don't, as Platsbanken reads the text. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: remote

parameters.description: Only ads published on or after this day. Leave empty for any time since 2016.
parameters.name: published_after

parameters.description: Only ads published on or before this day. Leave empty for up to the newest in the archive.
parameters.name: published_before

parameters.description: The order of the ads. Defaults to best match.
parameters.name: sort

parameters.description: How many ads to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matching ads to skip, for the next page: 10 skips the first ten. Platsbanken reads no further than 2,000 in.
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: How much of each ad's text to return, as plain text, up to 20,000 characters. Set 0 to leave the text out. Defaults to 500.
parameters.name: description_characters

description: Search every job ad on Platsbanken, Sweden's largest job board, run by Arbetsförmedlingen (the Swedish Public Employment Service): filter by occupation, region, municipality, employment type, working hours and date, read an ad in full with how to apply, count ads by occupation or place, follow the ads published or taken down, search ads back to 2016, and look up the occupation and skill taxonomy. Open data, no account needed.

jobtech_new_ad_trigger.description: Runs when an ad is published on Platsbanken that matches keywords, an occupation, a region or municipality, or an employment type, with its employer, place, terms, description and how to apply. Ads published before the workflow is turned on don't run it.
